column1: # A deliberate late patch, leave the pipeline alone.
# The ten lab-tested anchors reach Table S4 through addendum.csv, whose taxid column is blank for
# every one of them and whose kingdom column reads Bacteria for every one of them, MetN included.
# MetN is an archaeon, and its assembly is a metagenome-assembled genome that sits in neither
# assembly summary the pipeline reads, so nothing upstream can supply these values.
# These were read from NCBI by hand (esummary on each assembly, efetch on each taxid) on
# 2026-11-08 and are recorded here so that Table S4 can be correct without rerunning Stage 01.
# homolog_table.py overlays them on these ten rows and on nothing else.
# Do not propagate this file upstream, and do not treat it as a bug in addendum.csv to be fixed.
# It patches one table, on purpose, late.
